## Description

High-temperature synthetic filter media, catalogued in the filter-media category with a G4 grade. The source publishes 90/95% efficiency figures, an airflow of 5400 m³/h and dust-holding of 200/450 g/m². Synthetic fibre adds strength and washability for general HVAC duty, distinct from the fiberglass high-temperature option. Our advice: specify the target grade and application, and confirm roll width and grammage. Request an efficiency curve for the target particle size before bulk ordering.
